A member of the Team first needs to [authorize it](https://vercel.com/git/authorize?team=Vercel%20Labs&slug=vercel-labs&teamId=team_nO2mCG4W8IxPIeKoSsqwAxxB&type=github&job=%7B%22headInfo%22%3A%7B%22sha%22%3A%2268a365783c02488615b2b847de81f2196f255f76%22%7D%2C%22id%22%3A%22QmbbTt949vEoTaFGjHibNYbCKdT7ck3g94LNDGnEDBdj2S%22%2C%22org%22%3A%22vercel-labs%22%2C%22prId%22%3A10%2C%22repo%22%3A%22fx0%22%7D).

Hey @fazxes, I found this and opened a fix in #10. libfx sends the model request body as bytes, but fx0 only read text, so the 64-step limit never counted. The fix reads both, and the tests now send bytes like libfx does.

Further optimization will start with end-to-end tracing from submission to first response rather than this cross-function warm-up.
